name: Messaging
intro: Where messages and calls land reliably and privately, and where texts vanish.

apps.title: Telegram Messenger
apps.verdict: Telegram remains one of the most fully featured messengers: fast sync, channels, and cloud storage all work reliably. But editing messages breaks the keyboard, and signing in without a phone number is still not possible.
apps.loved: Fast message delivery, a lightweight client, and regular updates with genuinely new features.
apps.weak: The editor covers the text with the keyboard, making it nearly impossible to fix a message in a channel.
apps.whoFor: People who want a messenger with channels and file storage

quotes.text: Why do I need a number I can't even use anymore to sign in when my email is on the account, no other options but to leave the app after that.. It's 2026 make some progress
It would be better if the app allowed sign-up using both email and phone number, because I don't have a phone number but I want to download the app.
Telegram is fast, secure, and packed with useful features. The channels and cloud storage capabilities are amazing.

the app is illegal. There are a lot of advantages. I would really like to remove the "delete correspondence from both" button, as it is not very convenient, as it seems to me. When another person deletes the correspondence and clears it, all the photos, namely: memories, funny moments. A person can

apps.title: Signal - Private Messenger
apps.verdict: Signal encrypts properly and holds up on privacy, but message delivery delays and inconsistent voice call quality come up regularly in reviews. It is not ready to be someone's only messenger.
apps.loved: Users trust the app enough to build local communities around it and treat it as infrastructure.
apps.weak: Messages often hang on 'Delivering' for several hours, and voice calls drop and sound unstable.
apps.whoFor: People who value privacy over convenience

quotes.text: Yall have non to stop people from adding you in group chats over night im added into 50 group chats and can no longer open app because the amount of messages

This app is saving countless lives in Minnesota. I could not be more grateful Update, June 2026: Signal is still the beating heart of our neighborhood. It's core democracy infrastructure and we're blessed to have it

apps.title: TextingStory Chat Story Maker
apps.verdict: A rare tool for creating chat-format stories that kids and teenagers have used for years for fan fiction and roleplay scenes. The core mechanic works reliably, but gradual paywalling of previously free features like colors and avatars hurts the most active part of the audience.
apps.loved: The 'write a conversation' format offers an easy path into storytelling for people who do not like writing prose.
apps.weak: Basic character customization that used to be free is now behind a paywall, so stories all look the same.
apps.whoFor: Teen fan fiction writers and fans of roleplay stories

apps.title: WhatsApp Messenger
apps.verdict: A global messenger with end-to-end encryption that covers the basic need for internet-based communication. Its weak point is mass unjustified account bans with no real support path and reliability issues with video calls.
apps.loved: Works where there is no reliable cellular service and across borders without roaming charges.
apps.weak: The ban algorithm triggers on normal actions like messaging new contacts, and recovering an account is nearly impossible.
apps.whoFor: People who communicate with friends or family abroad

quotes.text: I changed my phone and tried to move my old contacts to my new phone via group message to tell my old contacts I'm on a new phone and I got banned. That's terrible service now I can't talk to my contacts and I have urgent messages to respond to.
Works great for communicating when normal phone connections are not available.
I can finally call my girls all together because someone has a Samsung while I have a iPhone

apps.title: WeChat
apps.verdict: Essential for staying in touch with Chinese relatives and colleagues, but registering without a contact already inside the platform is nearly impossible, and random account bans without explanation damage relationships with diaspora users. Calls and messaging are stable once you have an account.
apps.loved: Voice and video calls across borders work reliably and connect families in different countries.
apps.weak: Signing up requires scanning a QR code with someone else's account, which makes registration contingent on knowing the right person.
apps.whoFor: Chinese people living abroad and their families

quotes.text:
To create account dose not suppose to need membership help, is not making any sense 😂

apps.title: Marco Polo - Video Messenger
apps.verdict: Marco Polo is an async video messenger for family and close friends: record a video, the other person watches when convenient. The core works, but captions have been moved behind a paywall, recordings sometimes cut off mid-message, and transcripts recently disappeared.
apps.loved: The video-voicemail format removes the pressure to reply immediately and keeps communication feel personal even across large time zone gaps.
apps.weak: Subtitles and transcripts have been moved to a paid subscription, cutting off deaf and hard-of-hearing users.
apps.whoFor: Families and close friends who want to see each other's faces but live in different time zones

quotes.text: Best app to keep in touch with loved ones. Especially when you live on opposite coasts/ different time zones. So convenient. Message whenever & watch when you have time! I love Marco Polo!
Marco Polo has helped me and my friends stay completely connected during this busy phase of life, so when we are able to get together in person there's no "catching up" it's just having fun together!

My wife is deaf and can only watch our family Polos with captions! Very ableist and a dirty trick by the developers and needs to be reversed! Even people who aren't deaf or hard of hearing may like this feature to watch a Polo without the sound as to not disturb others.

The easiest way to communicate . . .
. . . "text messages" lead to misunderstanding a lot!
I wish it was free to close the app while listening to the video I want the ability to put the phone in my pocket while listening with my EarPods without the video stopping

It's really a huge disappointment. My whole family loved Marco Polo. It was our preferred method of keeping in touch. We would use the Sharecast feature for video updates of our kids. The ability to upload videos, the unlimited storage, even the transcripts of
Polos was great.

Hopefully this is just a bug, but the absolute best feature and the reason me and my developers where using pro and sharing was the transcript copy feature. This has been removed and it is rather frustrating.

apps.title: Messenger
apps.verdict: A messenger built on the Facebook network with good call and video quality. The main flaw is duplicate and delayed notifications, and a persistent Meta AI that cannot be turned off.
apps.loved: Video calls work cleanly and stably, connecting people across the world with no noticeable lag.
apps.weak: Read-message notifications repeat hours later, making it impossible to know what is actually new.
apps.whoFor: Facebook users who want to call and message in one place

quotes.text: The app is very useful for long-term conversations. But in the past few months, I've been getting notifications for "new" messages up to 24 hours after I've read them. Just now I got a notification for a message that I read over an hour ago.

Please bring back "Write with Meta AI" and keep it in Messenger. I used it daily for drafting messages, fixing tone, and brainstorming replies. It made Messenger way more useful. Removing it hurts the experience.
Meta AI suggestions are intrusive. Please add an option to disable or totally opt-out of Meta AI.

Why do you need to make me install another stupid app just to see the messages from facebook? You can say "because it is focused on messaging and makes it more organized" but when I want to watch a reel my wife sent me, I gotta open it again because it closes the whole thing

apps.title: Messages
apps.verdict: Apple's system messenger works as the default for anyone with an iPhone, but has accumulated real problems: texts 'teleport' between chats, group chat is capped at around 20 people, the sensitive content filter blocks harmless photos and interferes with calls. Message delivery reliability is questioned by a number of users.
apps.loved: Works without extra apps with any device including Android, and requires no registration.
apps.weak: The group chat participant limit and an unpredictable content filter that blocks normal photos and voice calls.
apps.whoFor: iPhone owners who want one messenger for everything

apps.title: Pronto Team Communication
apps.verdict: A team messenger designed for educational institutions with a solid foundation, but email login breaks, crashes happen after updates, and notification granularity leaves something to be desired.
apps.loved: Quick group replies and video calls run smoothly.
apps.weak: There is no notification setting between 'all messages' and 'mentions only', so the phone buzzes all day.
apps.whoFor: Students and work teams on institutional platforms

apps.title: Reach: Fast SMS Text and Email
apps.verdict: A solid tool for personalized mass SMS campaigns where each recipient sees an individual message. Sending speed is slow, support is hard to reach, and delivery reliability is inconsistent.
apps.loved: Each recipient gets a personal message rather than a group thread, which increases the chance of a reply.
apps.weak: Sending to a large group takes a long time, and each message requires a separate tap.
apps.whoFor: Organizers, coaches, and small businesses who need personalized SMS broadcasts

apps.title: Session - Private Messenger
apps.verdict: Privacy without a phone number and E2E encryption work, but notifications arrive hours late, video calls are unstable, and the read receipt setting appears in the toggle but does not function. Not suitable for urgent communication, but adequate for low-key private chatting.
apps.loved: Registration with no phone number or email: just an identifier, no personal attachment.
apps.weak: Notifications about new messages arrive with delays of up to several hours.
apps.whoFor: People who need maximum anonymity and can tolerate delivery delays

apps.title: Zoom Workplace
apps.verdict: Zoom is the de facto standard for video conferencing in remote work and education. Call quality is stable on a decent connection, but joining a session through the mobile app periodically breaks and forces a switch to the browser.
apps.loved: Brings people from different time zones into one video session with no setup needed — just a link, and everyone is in.
apps.weak: Locking the phone screen during an active meeting ends the call without warning.
apps.whoFor: Teams and study groups that need scheduled video meetings

apps.title: JusTalk - Video Chat & Calls
apps.verdict: A reliable option for video calls when FaceTime is unavailable or when cross-platform connectivity with Android users is needed. Picture quality is good, there are in-call games and drawing, but ads are intrusive and group calls perform worse than one-on-one.
apps.loved: Drawing on screen and mini-games during a video call make conversations feel alive.
apps.weak: Adult advertisements appear on a platform marketed for teen socializing.
apps.whoFor: Children and teenagers staying in touch with friends and family

quotes.text: I love being able to call friends when my Apple FaceTime does not work this is my go to app to call my friends I even recommended it to my family for family group chats
It's really good for some of my friends who have android
Amazing audio, great across platforms, and it is amazing for text

apps.title: Discord - Talk, Play, Hang Out
apps.verdict: Discord handles organized communication for gaming and interest-based communities: servers, channels, voice rooms. The weak point on mobile is unreliable verification at login and frequent forced logouts.
apps.loved: Voice channels with no need to call — just join and talk until you leave.
apps.weak: The CAPTCHA at login freezes on a blank screen, and getting back into an account often requires switching devices.
apps.whoFor: Gamers and online community members with persistent channels

quotes.text: I've been logged out after trying to to remove an old number I have no access to anymore. I've been trying for an hour to get back into it by using my email which won't work either. It wants me to use a number I have no access to anymore and it's bs and infuriating.

I've been logged out after trying to to remove an old number I have no access to anymore. I've been trying for an hour to get back into it by using my email which won't work either. It wants me to use a number I have no access to anymore and it's bs and infuriating. Please fix this discord

I've been using Discord for years now, and overall I genuinely love the app. I've made so many friendships through it over time, and it has honestly become one of my favorite platforms to communicate with people.
Discord is good for making friends being able to communicate through game servers and talk to people that don't have phone numbers

apps.title: iMe: Telegram AI Messenger
apps.verdict: A convenient Telegram client with additional features, but some are locked behind a paywall, ads are aggressive, and updates lag behind the official app. Without a VPN in Russia, stability is inconsistent.
apps.loved: Wide-format posts and extra customization tools on top of standard Telegram.
apps.weak: Updates arrive later than the official client, so new Telegram features do not appear right away.
apps.whoFor: Telegram users who want extended customization

apps.title: Emoji for Message - Text Maker
apps.verdict: A good library of symbols and fonts for decorating messages, but the keyboard periodically stops appearing after updates, and the delete button sits too close to the working area.
apps.loved: A huge collection of symbols and non-standard fonts that are easy to paste into any messenger.
apps.weak: No undo button means accidentally deleted text is gone for good.
apps.whoFor: People who decorate profiles and messages in games and social apps

apps.title: ChatGPT
apps.verdict: ChatGPT is an AI assistant, not a messenger in the traditional sense: no message delivery between people, no groups, no contact sync. Response quality is uneven: strong on text and creative tasks, weak on precise facts and consistent memory.
apps.loved: Answers complex questions faster and in more detail than a search engine.
apps.weak: Memory is inconsistent: it remembers facts about the user but then mixes up contexts and requires repeated reminders.
apps.whoFor: People who want an AI conversation partner for tasks, not a chat with other people

apps.title: Google Chat
apps.verdict: For internal work communication within Google Workspace it handles the job, but notifications drop out periodically, group chats require email invitations instead of simple adds, and Google Meet calls clutter the chat list with no way to remove them.
apps.loved: Cross-platform with no device lock-in, making it possible to message Android users where iMessage is unavailable.
apps.weak: Notifications regularly stop working and require reinstalling the app to restore them.
apps.whoFor: Teams on Google Workspace who need a work chat

quotes.text: Constant ghost notifications and messages not coming through.

I really wanted to text my friends I had an iPad but my friends had a Samsung then one day I found this app on my App Store recommended then I downloaded it as the best app that changed my life because I was able to text my friends now and make a group chat

apps.title: Messenger Kids
apps.verdict: Messenger Kids solves a real problem: giving a child a safe chat under parental control with no access from strangers. But video calls freeze, group chats fail to create, and dependence on a parent's Facebook account becomes a blocker at any point of failure.
apps.loved: Children can message and call only contacts approved by a parent — no strangers.
apps.weak: Video calls freeze and drop in the middle, and the problem is easy to reproduce.
apps.whoFor: Parents who want to give their child a messenger they can monitor

quotes.text: I don't think it's SO good because my dad said that he forgot his Facebook account and now I can't text with my billion friends that has this app. Almost all of my friends have this app but I don't just because my dad forgot his Facebook account.
why do I need a freaking Facebook account why not just have a normal password and email

apps.title: MySudo - Identity Protection
apps.verdict: MySudo is strong as a privacy platform with multiple Sudos for different contexts, but incoming calls sometimes go straight to voicemail, message sync has delays, and support does not respond.
apps.loved: Multiple isolated numbers and email addresses in one app provide real control over your digital footprint.
apps.weak: Incoming calls regularly fail to ring and drop to voicemail without notifying the user.
apps.whoFor: People who take their privacy seriously

apps.title: Text Story Maker - ChatTales
apps.verdict: ChatTales does one thing well: simulates a conversation between two people for storytelling and pranks. The two-character limit in the free version cuts off content creators right at the start.
apps.loved: A realistic iOS-style chat simulation that works well for short stories and pranks.
apps.weak: The free version does not allow a third participant, making group conversations unavailable.
apps.whoFor: Text story creators and reaction video authors

apps.title: Heylo | Build community groups
apps.verdict: For small offline communities like running clubs or interest groups it works well enough: events, chat, and members are all in one place. The main weakness is notifications that arrive late or not at all, and there is no search through message history, which is painful for an active group.
apps.loved: Combines an events calendar with a group chat in one tool without extra switching.
apps.weak: Notifications are unreliable, and there is no message search — very inconvenient in large groups.
apps.whoFor: Organizers of offline communities: clubs, activity groups, interest meetups

apps.title: MEGA: Encrypted Cloud Storage
apps.verdict: MEGA stores files with zero-knowledge encryption and a generous free tier, but video playback regularly stalls due to bandwidth quotas and encryption latency, and losing the recovery key means permanent loss of access to the account.
apps.loved: End-to-end encryption and 20 GB of free storage with convenient file sharing.
apps.weak: Video streaming constantly buffers even on a fast connection due to server-side bandwidth limits.
apps.whoFor: Anyone who needs a private storage solution with a large free quota

apps.title: BiP - Messenger, Video Call
apps.verdict: Call quality is good — audio and video work stably — but registration via SMS code often fails and blocks new users at the door.
apps.loved: Audio and video calls work without lag even on a poor connection.
apps.weak: The SMS verification code frequently does not arrive, and after several failed attempts the account gets locked.
apps.whoFor: Users in Russia looking for a replacement for blocked messengers

apps.title: Zoho Cliq - Team Communication
apps.verdict: Zoho Cliq integrates reasonably well with the Zoho ecosystem, but the mobile app is unstable: it crashes on older iPhones, logs itself out spontaneously, and drops notifications. That is not enough for reliable team communication.
apps.loved: Tight integration with other Zoho products means fewer browser tabs to juggle.
apps.weak: The app logs out on its own, causing notifications to disappear at the worst possible moment.
apps.whoFor: Teams already working in Zoho One who need a built-in team chat

apps.title: Hit Em Up: Mass Text Bulk SMS
apps.verdict: The idea of sending one message to a large contact list without creating a group thread is useful and workable. But as the list grows, sending speed drops sharply, the app hangs mid-broadcast, and updates periodically wipe contacts. Reliability is not enough for regular professional use.
apps.loved: Lets you send a personal message to hundreds of people individually rather than in a shared thread.
apps.weak: With large lists (300+ contacts) the broadcast stalls and will not complete without a manual restart.
apps.whoFor: Event organizers and small businesses with regular mass broadcasts

apps.title: magicApp Calling & Messaging
apps.verdict: The MagicJack VoIP app is stable enough for domestic voice calls, but suffers from system-level limitations: no MMS or photo support, spam calls reach the private number, and the call drops when the screen turns off. International calls are unreliable.
apps.loved: Lets you call US numbers from abroad as if it were a local call, with no roaming charges.
apps.weak: No way to send or receive photos or files — only text and voice.
apps.whoFor: Americans who need a second number for calls without giving out their main one

quotes.text: Love this app. Allows me to be reachable but not give out my cell phone number.

Update: the texting function needs to have full functionality as it can't send or receive images. Beats having to depend on the magic jack device itself. When I go abroad I can make wifi calls to the U.S. as a local call by just using my phone.

The phone app and service is good . But I get 5 to 6 calls from unknown numbers though the magic phone number is available to me and my wife only and we have not shared the number with anybody else. It's really annoying to receive lot of such calls including marketing calls.
95% of calls Are from scams and phone harassment

apps.title: Yubo: Chat Meet & Make Friends
apps.verdict: The app works as a social network for young people, face verification filters out some fakes, but basic messaging features are hidden behind coins, match locations are global instead of local, and bans arrive without any clear reason.
apps.loved: Users genuinely meet and build relationships — several reviews describe couples who got together through the app.
apps.weak: Incoming messages and friend requests cannot be seen without payment, making connecting impossible without spending money.
apps.whoFor: Teenagers and young adults up to 22 looking for new friends online

apps.title: Gaze: Live Video Chat App
apps.verdict: A live video chat app for strangers that worked better when it had a random matching feature, which was removed. Now calls drop after 10 to 30 seconds, coins are deducted during technical failures without refunds, and moderation fails to handle repeat offenders.
apps.loved: When video works stably, it genuinely connects users with real people and no bots.
apps.weak: Removing the random video call feature took away the main reason users chose this app.
apps.whoFor: People who want live video conversations with strangers around shared interests

apps.title: Rakuten Viber Messenger
apps.verdict: Basic messaging and calls work stably, but the forced ChatGPT integration with no way to disable it triggered widespread discontent and hurt the rating. The product is losing trust because of changes users never consented to.
apps.loved: Voice and video calls abroad work without notable interruptions, which users with family in other countries appreciate.
apps.weak: ChatGPT is embedded permanently in the chat feed and cannot be removed even through settings — the disable option does not work.
apps.whoFor: Diaspora communities and families communicating across countries

quotes.text: I've been using Viber for years and have been very happy with it. I'm able to communicate by phone, text or video with loved ones who live abroad. Signal continues to improve. I have no complaints.

Remove chat gpt. I understand it's optional to use but I don't want it there at all. I want it gone. I don't want random message tab with chat GPT that drives me insane that I can't hide it, i don't want the bar on bottom show the icon in the center. Make it gone. I will never use it, never did.

now why tf are we having chatgpt in viber. im okay with viber since 2016 and now why we attached ai in a communication app required 0 ai involved. and i cant even delete it or take it off???? pls fix this

Viber pushed ChatGPT features on me that is intrusive. It is impossible to delete ChatGPT from my chat list. ChatGPT will appear in my chats with other users asking me to prompt things like remixing pictures. The app errors when I try to disconnect ChatGPT in the settings.

apps.title: Burner: Second Phone Number
apps.verdict: Burner provides a real second number for calls and SMS and has served as a work line for years — that is genuine value. But the app takes 20 seconds to open, message history sometimes fails to load at all, and notifications do not arrive from unknown numbers.
apps.loved: A permanent second number that works for business calls without a second phone.
apps.weak: The app takes an unusually long time to launch — up to 20 seconds on a modern iPhone.
apps.whoFor: Freelancers and small businesses who need a separate work number

quotes.text: Very good app and reasonable prices, i dont have to worry about using my personal numbers and get lots of spam calls and this is a good way to have a second number for work then carrying around two phones!

I have used this app as the primary line for my business, and it has performed very well. After five years of flawless service, I experienced an issue in early 2026 that required assistance from Burner Support, and they resolved it in a timely manner.

apps.title: Google Voice
apps.verdict: Google Voice remains useful as a second number for call screening, but long-standing reliability issues have worsened: missed calls with no ring, failures when picking up, and Google silently reassigning numbers to other users without warning.
apps.loved: A permanent Google account number for registrations and as a screen for incoming calls.
apps.weak: Calls go to voicemail without ringing on the device, and the recipient has no idea.
apps.whoFor: Google Workspace users who need a US number

quotes.text: Worked great until suddenly all my clients were unable to reach me, and I discovered they had taken my phone number away. It's now assigned to someone else and I'll have to print new business cards. Do not use Google voice.

apps.title: KakaoTalk : Messenger
apps.verdict: A messenger for Korean audiences with rich customization and good photo quality, but largely unusable for users outside Korea: contact search does not work, ads appear directly in personal chats as fake messages, and constant verification prompts on login are annoying.
apps.loved: Photos are transferred without quality loss, and the profile can be customized in more detail than most messengers allow.
apps.weak: Ads are embedded in the personal message feed and are visually indistinguishable from real chats.
apps.whoFor: People who communicate with Korean contacts or are learning Korean

apps.title: Second Texting Number:Unlisted
apps.verdict: The second number works for text messages in normal use, but calls frequently drop, photos disappear, and delivery reliability is questionable.
apps.loved: Getting multiple numbers in one app is convenient for separating personal and work contacts.
apps.weak: Calls consistently drop mid-conversation, making voice communication unreliable.
apps.whoFor: People who need an anonymous number for text messaging only, without relying on calls

apps.title: Garmin Messenger™
apps.verdict: The inReach device itself works reliably as a satellite communicator, but the companion app is unintuitive, suffers from pairing failures, and requires an internet connection in places where the entire point is to work without one.
apps.loved: Reliable satellite communication in areas with no network coverage at all.
apps.weak: Some basic features require an internet connection, even though the device exists specifically to work without one.
apps.whoFor: Hikers and travelers in areas without cellular coverage

apps.title: EXTENSION.app
apps.verdict: This is essentially a browser with picture-in-picture, not a messenger. For background video playback it works reasonably well, but after updates X/Twitter stopped opening, links from other apps do not open, and there is no way to save a list of favorite URLs. As a communication tool it has almost no value.
apps.loved: Video from any website plays in PIP mode without ads and in the background.
apps.weak: No URL saving — you have to type the address manually every time.
apps.whoFor: iPhone users who want to watch YouTube in the background without a subscription

apps.title: Second Texting Number
apps.verdict: A second number for texts is issued quickly and works in basic mode, but for some users it stops functioning after a few days and support only offers to unsubscribe. Suitable for one-off tasks, not ongoing use.
apps.loved: Instant delivery of a separate number without changing the SIM card.
apps.weak: Contacts disappear from the address book without any visible reason and cannot be recovered.
apps.whoFor: People who want a separate number for marketplaces or dating apps

quotes.text:
Great app for privacy, does exactly what it promises.
I've been using Second Texting Number and it works great. If you need a second number to protect your real one, whether for online marketplaces, dating apps, work contacts, or anything else, this is the app to get. Setup is quick, texts go throug

apps.title: Text Vault - Texting App
apps.verdict: An anonymous SMS app that works stably for basic texts for some users, but for others messages never reach recipients — especially after payment. Support does not respond.
apps.loved: Lets you pick a number with a desired area code and start texting right away.
apps.weak: After activating a paid number, SMS delivery can stop entirely with no explanation.
apps.whoFor: People who need a temporary anonymous number for one-off messaging

apps.title: Kinzoo: Fun All-Ages Messenger
apps.verdict: Text messaging works stably, but video calls drop constantly, audio echoes, and connection depends on the network. Fine as a text messenger, not as a video call tool.
apps.loved: A closed environment where children can message only adult contacts approved by a parent.
apps.weak: Video calls drop and freeze, making voice communication unreliable.
apps.whoFor: Parents who want to give their child a safe messenger under their own control

apps.title: Text Yourself－Chat Story Maker
apps.verdict: The SMS conversation simulator for storytelling works as intended, but aggressive review prompts and a mandatory paywall from the first launch drive users away.
apps.loved: A realistic SMS dialogue interface lets you create engaging text stories.
apps.weak: Pop-ups asking for a rating interrupt the workflow right in the middle of creating a story.
apps.whoFor: Teenagers who make text stories to share on social media

apps.title: Microsoft Teams
apps.verdict: Microsoft Teams is a corporate platform for chat and calls that most users install on employer demand. The unread message counter is chronically wrong, sync between devices lags, and the app hijacks FaceTime calls.
apps.loved: For basic work chats and scheduled meetings it behaves predictably.
apps.weak: The unread badge does not reset correctly for months on end, making it impossible to navigate the message queue.
apps.whoFor: Corporate Microsoft 365 users with no alternative

quotes.text: Для корпоративной работы всё в целом работает нормально, но очень не хватает двух функций. Первая отправка сообщений по расписанию. Бывает, что что-то вспоминаю ночью и хочу написать коллеге, но понимаю, что писать в такое время некорректно. В таких ситуациях функция отложенной отправки была бы кр
Badge count is wrong a lot. Have to manually mark messages as read.

I don't know what changed but the recent update is causing the Teams app to show a notification alert badge when there is no new activity or I have caught up with all activity. I keep thinking I have a new message or alert and I go check and there's nothing new to check. Then the badge goes away and

Teams appears to have an issue with displaying the actual number of unread chats and is showing multiples when there is only one.
In addition, Teams doesn't appear to be syncing with other devices and adjusting the number of unread chats when they are read on another devise.

apps.title: textPlus: Text Message + Call
apps.verdict: TextPlus provides a virtual number where no real one is available, and that is its core value. But messages get stuck on 'sent' with no delivery confirmation, calls drop without warning, and accounts are blocked unpredictably.
apps.loved: Works as a backup number for registrations and calls when a real SIM is unavailable.
apps.weak: Message delivery status does not update — a conversation can disappear until the app is restarted.
apps.whoFor: Anyone who needs a one-time US number for verification

apps.title: Love Messages, Birthday Wishes
apps.verdict: A collection of ready-made greetings and messages with a wide library, but text quality is uneven: many templates contain errors or sound generic. This is an inspiration tool, not a live messenger.
apps.loved: A large library of greetings for different occasions that is updated regularly.
apps.weak: Some templates are written with errors or use outdated phrasing.
apps.whoFor: People who want a ready-made card or greeting without having to write one themselves

apps.title: WA Web - Dual Messenger ⁺
apps.verdict: The WhatsApp Web wrapper works, but the session resets almost daily — which defeats the purpose of persistent access. Ads are aggressive and appear inside chats.
apps.loved: Lets you keep WhatsApp open on a device without the main account, which is handy for a second SIM.
apps.weak: The session drops on its own repeatedly, requiring the QR code to be scanned again and again.
apps.whoFor: Users with two numbers or without the official WhatsApp app on their device

apps.title: Copy Text On Screen
apps.verdict: An OCR tool for copying text from the screen that works decently in typical scenarios, but handwritten text recognition is poor and accuracy dropped noticeably after updates. This app has no messaging features and is not a messenger.
apps.loved: Recognizes printed text from photos accurately enough and requires no complex setup.
apps.weak: Handwritten text is recognized with errors, and OCR quality has declined after updates.
apps.whoFor: Anyone who needs to quickly copy text from a photo or screenshot

apps.title: WhatsApp Business
apps.verdict: WhatsApp Business adds a business profile, catalog, and auto-replies on top of regular WhatsApp, but after several updates the app stopped launching reliably on older iPhones and suppresses the busy-line notification during an incoming call.
apps.loved: A business profile with a catalog and quick replies reduces routine when working with customers through WhatsApp.
apps.weak: The app does not show a 'busy' status to callers, so clients call again and again while interrupting an ongoing conversation.
apps.whoFor: Small businesses whose audience is already on WhatsApp

quotes.text: You guys are banning my accounts too much I am a business man if I want to message a customer first you guys will restrict me I have had like 10 numbers and you guys keep restricting this new update is really stressing me and I hate it

I've noticed that WhatsApp no longer notifies users when the person they are calling is already on another call. This is causing a significant disruption for me. Because callers don't see a 'busy' or 'on another call' status, they keep calling repeatedly, which interrupts important conversations.

apps.title: Private Texting SMS Phone Text
apps.verdict: An anonymous SMS service that works for simple texts, but cannot send photos, limits message length, and requires credits even for basic actions.
apps.loved: Sending messages without linking a real number covers the need for anonymity.
apps.weak: Attachments and long texts are unavailable without a paid plan, which breaks normal conversation.
apps.whoFor: Anyone who needs to send an anonymous message once and does not expect a photo reply

apps.title: Talkatone: WiFi Text & Calls
apps.verdict: Talkatone provides a free Wi-Fi number, but message delivery reliability is inconsistent: outgoing messages are flagged as 'spam' during normal conversations, verification codes do not arrive, and support is effectively unavailable.
apps.loved: Easy to get a number without personal data and start calling for free.
apps.weak: The anti-spam system blocks outgoing messages if you send several in a row during a normal exchange.
apps.whoFor: Anyone who needs a free Wi-Fi number for calls in the US without a real SIM

quotes.text: To many spam callers

apps.title: Clapper: Video, Live, Chat
apps.verdict: Positioned as a TikTok alternative for older audiences, but basic messenger features break regularly: messages do not send, live stream notifications disappear, and new accounts become invisible to other users.
apps.loved: A platform without heavy moderation gives a sense of free expression for older audiences.
apps.weak: The content feed algorithm is unpredictable and pays little attention to the user's language and interests.
apps.whoFor: Content creators looking for a TikTok alternative

apps.title: Snapchat
apps.verdict: Snapchat is a messenger with disappearing messages and AR filters, but its core — snap delivery — breaks regularly: videos do not display, notifications ignore disabled categories, and sessions crash. The product is degrading under monetization pressure.
apps.loved: Disappearing messages and AR lenses still make communication feel visually alive.
apps.weak: Notifications ignore user settings and push filter ads regardless.
apps.whoFor: Teenagers who communicate through images rather than text

quotes.text: I have always loved Snapchat, I've had it for about 7 years now and I have penalty of amazing memories that mean so much to me but Snapchat now is currently charging for storage and if you do not pay for storage it will be deleting your memories in 12 months and it's completely breaking my heart

This app is not what it used to be! The only reason I still have snap is bc of my streaks! One day Snapchat is going to make it where you can't use the app unless you pay and when that day comes, I'm deleting it and there goes my childhood

apps.title: Textkiller - Spam Text Blocker
apps.verdict: A spam message blocker that worked well for the first few months, then degraded: it lets spam through, blocks important messages from pharmacies and doctors, and does not work on Mac or iPad.
apps.loved: At its best the filter genuinely brings spam down to zero with no manual configuration.
apps.weak: The filter loses precision after updates and starts blocking legitimate messages from real senders.
apps.whoFor: iPhone users willing to tolerate instability in exchange for a quiet period with no spam

apps.title: Group Text | Mass Message
apps.verdict: The mass SMS app used to work for years, but after recent updates it reliably sends messages to only part of the recipient list. Support is silent. The core feature is broken.
apps.loved: Used to let organizers send a personal SMS to hundreds of contacts in one tap without a group thread.
apps.weak: After updates, the message only goes to the last contact added, not the full group.
apps.whoFor: Church community and club organizers who need mass SMS broadcasts

apps.title: GoChat Messenger
apps.verdict: The app is positioned as a messenger for international video calls, but basic problems have gone unsolved for years: the call automatically drops after 5 minutes, audio does not switch to AirPods without hanging up and calling back, and messages appear out of chronological order. Group video calls are absent.
apps.loved: Users in the UAE note stable video quality where other apps are blocked.
apps.weak: Calls drop automatically after 5 minutes, and audio through headphones does not switch without hanging up.
apps.whoFor: Users in countries with restricted access to WhatsApp and FaceTime

apps.title: TextNow: Call + Text Unlimited
apps.verdict: Basic SMS delivery works adequately, but calls are interrupted by ads mid-conversation, spam calls target even paying users, and support is unreachable. The product is unreliable as a primary communication channel.
apps.loved: Quick setup of a second number and eSIM activation without visiting a store.
apps.weak: Spam calls are not blocked even on the paid plan, making it hard to tell a real contact from a robot.
apps.whoFor: Anyone who needs a temporary number for a one-time registration

quotes.text: This app really helps people to have a business number so they would not mix their personal one. And the pranks are unlimited 😭🙏 I would love to have numbers of my area ❤️

I get anywhere from 1-3 spam calls a day and that's with the paid version. Horrible for my business as it's confusing to know who is a real person vs spam. I'm wasting time and money calling these numbers back each time.

The amount of spam calls is nauseating. There's no way to make the calls stop or put a stop to the app notification. I turned them off from my phone settings but them calls keep coming in. I am talking about 5 or more scam calls about debt relief.

apps.title: Wakie Chat: Meet new people
apps.verdict: An app for random voice encounters that suffers from poor call quality, aggressive and inappropriate content, and opaque account bans.
apps.loved: Live calls with strangers from different countries provide a sense of real human connection.
apps.weak: Moderation cannot keep up with sexual content and scammers, and the atmosphere deteriorates quickly.
apps.whoFor: People who want to talk to a stranger right now

apps.title: BFF: Make friends & meet up
apps.verdict: BFF fails at the basics: messages do not send, sessions crash, and phone verification works intermittently. The interest-group concept is solid, but the audience is too small to feel it.
apps.loved: Interest-based groups genuinely ease the first contact and remove the awkwardness of a one-on-one.
apps.weak: Messages stall or do not arrive, especially after a session break.
apps.whoFor: People looking for offline friends who are willing to put up with instability

apps.title: Wizz App - chat now
apps.verdict: The app bans well-behaved users due to errors in the automated verification system and does not respond to appeals, while continuing to charge for subscriptions. The core dating and messaging function is unreliable.
apps.loved: Mandatory face verification reduces the number of fakes compared to similar apps.
apps.weak: The automated ban triggers at registration without any violation, and there is no way to appeal through support.
apps.whoFor: Young people looking for friends through short video introductions

quotes.text:
I had to erase the app because of too much bugs they were having and I downloaded right now and when I was gonna make my account. It said I was banned. Like what. "You have been banned
Because you shared a picture, a post or a message that infringes our terms & conditions" what. Never shared a pic

apps.title: Messenger Multi Business
apps.verdict: Messenger Multi Business is an unofficial WhatsApp client for iPad and multi-account use that requires constant re-syncing while retaining access to the user's account. Sync drops daily, QR codes are flagged as invalid, and video calls have poor audio.
apps.loved: The free version provides the main WhatsApp features with only a single banner at the bottom of the screen.
apps.weak: The session drops every day and requires scanning the QR code again, which defeats the whole idea of multi-device access.
apps.whoFor: iPad owners who need WhatsApp without a second phone nearby

quotes.text: Compared to other WhatsApp clients, I prefer this one because the free version more or less provides the all of the common WhatsApp features with only a single ad banner at the footer. The premium versions not only frees you from ads, but it unlocks there "fancy" features like four account support

apps.title: Pinger: Call Plus Texting App
apps.verdict: A virtual number for calls and texts that is unreliable: audio is quiet or muffled, message notifications drop, and accounts are blocked without warning. Reliability is at the level of a backup number, not a primary one.
apps.loved: Quick setup of a second number for separating personal and work contacts.
apps.weak: Calls frequently drop or sound muffled underwater, making them unsuitable for business conversations.
apps.whoFor: Anyone who needs a temporary backup number

quotes.text: I've used Pinger for years, then the account is restricted in the sudden. I contacted support and got a generic "Your account has been blocked for violating our Terms of Service" response. I wish Pinger gave me a warning first, so I had a chance to either stop doing whatever it didn't like or move t

apps.title: Messages & Quotes for WhatsApp
apps.verdict: This is not a messenger but a catalog of ready-made phrases and quotes to forward on WhatsApp. It works as a utility: copy text and send. But ads insert a download link into copied text, which annoys recipients.
apps.loved: A large library of ready-made messages for holidays and occasions — no writing required.
apps.weak: When copying text, the app automatically appends an ad link to the app download page.
apps.whoFor: People who regularly congratulate loved ones and do not want to write something each time

apps.title: Superfy: Meet real people
apps.verdict: The social chat for meeting people has deteriorated: moderation stopped working, content has become coarser, and users receive permanent bans without explanation or any way to appeal.
apps.loved: At launch the app created a live community where people genuinely answered questions and made connections.
apps.weak: The ban system is opaque and inconsistent: well-behaved users are blocked while actual violators keep using the app.
apps.whoFor: Teenagers over 16 looking for casual conversation, if they can tolerate chaotic moderation

apps.title: New Text Tones
apps.verdict: The app offers a collection of notification sounds, but installing a chosen tone on iPhone without iTunes is extremely difficult, and the custom tone creation feature may not work after payment.
apps.loved: A large library of non-standard sounds that are not available in the default iOS set.
apps.weak: Setting a tone on the device requires iTunes and several manual steps, which puts most users off.
apps.whoFor: iPhone users willing to deal with iTunes for a non-standard notification sound

apps.title: GroupMe
apps.verdict: GroupMe holds on in the niche of group chats for schools and teams, but basic features are broken: messages get lost in open chats, pins disappeared after an update, and logging in becomes a cycle of password resets.
apps.loved: Group chats work across mobile platforms, which is convenient for mixed-platform teams.
apps.weak: Messages regularly get lost even when the chat is open and active — which undermines the entire point of reliable group communication.
apps.whoFor: School and sports groups stuck on this platform

quotes.text: Love it use it for so many groups I wish there was a way for the calendar to sync to you Apple or google calendar. The app only improves I love the calendar and reminders, the ability to pin a message, you can make different text threads I use one as the main chat and make another for forms that the
With the most recent update you can't schedule events for a specific time. Very annoying as our games start at odd times like 8:40.

You're supposed to be able to share PDF and other files directly within GroupMe, but it's not an option via my iPhone 17 Pro. Supposedly an interface problem with IOS. Otherwise a great app, like a dedicated text thread, only you can add & subtract members without creating a new thread. Polls, Eve

apps.title: Clubhouse
apps.verdict: The app lost its audience after the pandemic and now suffers from intrusive notifications, a broken in-room chat, and a creator reward program that does not pay what it promises. It is no longer reliable as a communication tool.
apps.loved: Those who stayed have found a close community and spend up to 14 hours a day in rooms.
apps.weak: The chat inside an active room does not show new messages until you leave and rejoin.
apps.whoFor: Audio fans who joined back in 2020 and never left

quotes.text: OK so I've been here since a month after the App launched initially. Some of the people on this app are my closest and dearest friends them are coworkers, mentors, coaches, Family.

apps.title: BIGO LIVE-Live Stream, Go Live
apps.verdict: Bigo Live is a streaming platform with chat and virtual gifts, not a full messenger. Bans arrive without explanation and can last up to a year, moderation is inconsistent, and private messages are rife with scam schemes.
apps.loved: Streamers appreciate the live audience and the gifting system, which actually works.
apps.weak: The matching algorithm ignores gender and orientation settings and shows irrelevant people.
apps.whoFor: Mobile streamers who want a live audience with donation support

apps.title: 2nd Line - Second phone number
apps.verdict: A second number with opaque pricing: users report unexpected charges during the 'free' period, message history disappears, and settings are glitchy.
apps.loved: The idea of a separate number for work contacts without a second SIM is convenient.
apps.weak: Messages disappear and message history is not retained, making the app unreliable.
apps.whoFor: Not recommended for anyone in its current state

apps.title: Walkie Talkie - All Talk App
apps.verdict: A social walkie-talkie for random conversations around the world, but recent updates removed key modes and broke basic channel navigation. Long-time users are leaving precisely because the app stopped being itself.
apps.loved: The atmosphere of random voice encounters and the feel of a live radio broadcast.
apps.weak: Duet conversations and frequency shuffling — the mechanics that drove discovery — have been removed.
apps.whoFor: Fans of voice chats with strangers

apps.title: LINE
apps.verdict: LINE is losing users in the US because login without an old device is impossible and phone number registration is blocked. Media delivery is unreliable even for existing users.
apps.loved: Stickers and the app's atmosphere work well within the Japanese market.
apps.weak: Transferring an account to a new device is virtually impossible without simultaneous access to the old one.
apps.whoFor: Users in Japan and Asia who have been on the same device for a long time

apps.title: Blink - Make New Friends
apps.verdict: Blink is positioned as a friend-finding app, but phone number verification breaks, fake and potentially unsafe profiles appear frequently, and core features work unpredictably.
apps.loved: The concept of quickly meeting compatible people without a romantic framing appeals to part of the audience.
apps.weak: Phone verification fails regularly, blocking new users from getting in.
apps.whoFor: Teenagers and young adults looking for new friends online

apps.title: Dust - a safer place to text
apps.verdict: The app was built on privacy trust but has degraded: notifications are broken, sending photos and videos does not work, and copy-paste was removed in an update. The core messenger function — reliable delivery and notifications — is not working.
apps.loved: Messages disappear after 24 hours without any configuration, anonymously and with no extra steps.
apps.weak: Notifications for incoming messages arrive inconsistently or not at all.
apps.whoFor: People who want an anonymous ephemeral chat and can accept limited functionality

apps.title: Text Me - Phone Call + Texting
apps.verdict: Messages get stuck on 'sending', incoming images do not arrive, calls drop, and accounts are blocked without warning or any path to appeal. The product is unreliable as a communication channel.
apps.loved: Works as a backup number when you need to reach someone who has blocked your main contact.
apps.weak: The spam algorithm blocks conversations with real people, including family members, without explanation.
apps.whoFor: People who want to hide their real number from a specific contact

apps.title: Plus: Dual Messenger for iPad
apps.verdict: The app is positioned as a way to run a second WhatsApp on iPad, but it is essentially just a browser wrapper opening web.whatsapp.com. Message sync breaks after updates, and users who realize what they actually bought feel misled.
apps.loved: For anyone who needs a second WhatsApp account on the same device, the concept works.
apps.weak: After updates, sync with the main WhatsApp breaks and messages stop loading.
apps.whoFor: iPad users with two WhatsApp numbers who need quick access from a tablet

apps.title: Moco - Chat, Meet People
apps.verdict: A social messenger for dating where ads literally cover interface buttons and make the chat inaccessible without a paid subscription. Live streaming was removed from the app entirely. Message sending is unreliable.
apps.loved: Over years of operation it has gathered a real community of regular users who have been there a long time.
apps.weak: Ad banners cover the bottom navigation menu and make it impossible to tap the chat buttons.
apps.whoFor: Users who registered long ago and came for a specific social circle

apps.title: Text Free: Second Phone Number
apps.verdict: Calls drop after an hour, ads redirect to potentially harmful pages, incoming call notifications do not trigger, and registration often hits an error wall. The product does not reliably perform basic functions.
apps.loved: For tablets without a SIM card it is one of the few ways to text Android contacts.
apps.weak: Incoming calls go straight to voicemail with no chance for the user to answer.
apps.whoFor: Tablet owners without a SIM who need some kind of number

quotes.text: I'm a tablet user so I have had great difficulty communicating with people who don't have apple products, so this has been a great fix! However, there are some issues.

apps.title: Zangi - Private Messenger
apps.verdict: The messenger breaks regularly after updates and crashes when switching between apps. Media delivery is unreliable. Using it for work is risky.
apps.loved: When it is working stably, the interface resembles familiar messengers and requires no learning curve.
apps.weak: The app crashes every time it enters the background and hangs after updates.
apps.whoFor: Users who need private messaging without linking a phone number

apps.title: Azar: Chat, Meet Friends
apps.verdict: Azar started as a random video chat for meeting strangers, but a new update replaced random matches with gem-based invites. Users are demanding a rollback en masse, credits are deducted without connections being made, and there is no way to search by username.
apps.loved: The idea of a random video chat with people from around the world was alive and worked before the update.
apps.weak: There is no way to find someone by username — only a random match or invite — making reconnection impossible.
apps.whoFor: People who want to video chat with strangers from other countries

apps.title: Connected2.me
apps.verdict: An anonymous communication app where the core feature of sending messages periodically stops working after updates. Notifications do not lead to the right chat, and content moderation is nearly absent. Much of the audience has been inactive for years.
apps.loved: An anonymous profile allows communication without any attachment to a real identity.
apps.weak: Messages stall on sending indefinitely, and new chat notifications do not open the right conversation.
apps.whoFor: People looking for anonymous communication with strangers without revealing their identity

apps.title: Hippo - Meet New Friends
apps.loved: At one point it offered live video introductions with real people.
apps.weak: Matches have become pre-recorded videos rather than a live stream.
apps.whoFor: Not recommended for anyone in its current state

apps.title: Direct Message : Click to Chat
apps.verdict: The app is positioned as a shortcut for messaging on WhatsApp without saving a contact, but basic features do not work: devices keep disconnecting, the QR code must be scanned every time, and phone numbers are not recognized. This is not a messenger — it is a wrapper that breaks on first real use.
apps.loved: The idea of opening a chat with an unknown number in one tap is convenient for businesses and services.
apps.weak: The device connection drops constantly and requires re-linking via QR code.
apps.whoFor: Small businesses that need quick chats without saving contacts

apps.title: Comera
apps.verdict: After updates call quality dropped sharply: missed calls do not appear in notifications, OTP codes do not arrive on re-login, and group calls have no audio. The app is unstable for regular communication.
apps.loved: Works in the UAE where other messengers are blocked.
apps.weak: Incoming calls do not appear in phone notifications unless the app is opened manually.
apps.whoFor: Users in countries with VoIP call restrictions

apps.title: Social Chat: Make New Friends
apps.verdict: An anonymous-chat social app for meeting people that suffers from slow media loading, freezes on re-login, and a complete absence of audience filtering. Video sending is so slow that users assume the feature is broken. The quality of interaction depends on the audience makeup — and it is inconsistent here.
apps.loved: There is a live audience from different countries, and some conversations genuinely take off.
apps.weak: Video does not send properly, and the app freezes on re-login via Google.
apps.whoFor: People looking for casual chat with strangers around the world

apps.title: Text App: Wifi Calling+Texting
apps.verdict: The app positions itself as a Wi-Fi call and text tool, but incoming texts disappear from the interface, incoming calls interrupt and drop the current call, and verification codes from third-party services never arrive. The core use case does not work.
apps.loved: The concept works on paper: a second number via Wi-Fi without a physical SIM card.
apps.weak: Received messages disappear from history with no trace of delivery.
apps.whoFor: Anyone who needs a second number for Wi-Fi calls — if they can find a working alternative

apps.title: SayHi Chat - Meet New People
apps.verdict: SayHi is overrun by scammers and fake accounts, voice calls do not work for some users, and a points system restricts communication. Finding a genuine conversation partner is difficult.
apps.loved: There are real users from different countries, and some of them genuinely want to connect.
apps.weak: Moderation cannot handle the volume of scammers and extortionists, which poisons the entire experience.
apps.whoFor: People looking for language exchange partners who are willing to filter out scammers themselves

apps.title: TalkU: Unlimited Calls + Texts
apps.verdict: A VoIP call and SMS app with a virtual number where text messages consistently fail to reach recipients, calls drop due to network issues, and you can only manage a group you created yourself. Support does not respond for months.
apps.loved: The approach works for privacy: a separate number with no SIM card attachment.
apps.weak: You cannot join a group created by another user — only your own.
apps.whoFor: Not recommended for anyone in its current state

apps.title: TeleNow: Call & Text Unlimited
apps.verdict: A virtual phone number app for calls and SMS that issues a number but after payment calling does not actually work: no dial tone, SMS do not arrive, verification codes never come through. The payment structure is confusing — a subscription does not include minutes, you have to buy coins separately.
apps.loved: The need for a second number without a SIM is real, and occasionally after a long wait calls do go through.
apps.weak: After payment, calls and SMS often do not work at all and verification codes do not arrive.
apps.whoFor: Users who need a temporary second number for verification

apps.title: Second Phone Number -Texts App
apps.verdict: The app consistently fails to deliver SMS and calls after activation: numerous reviews document the same thing — messages do not reach sender or recipient, credits are spent with nothing sent, and support does not respond. The core virtual number feature does not work.
apps.loved: The ability to choose a number from a list at registration is a convenient and clear experience.
apps.weak: SMS do not reach the recipient even with an active balance and a working connection.

quotes.text: When you log in to your bank or credit card sites they call or text a code to verify identity. This number doesn't support that. When I complained (politely) to customer service, they told me it was due to "force majeure" and there was nothing they could do about it.

apps.title: Text Number-Phone Text Message
apps.verdict: Messages do not arrive, assigned phone numbers are lost while the subscription is active, and support does not respond. The virtual number as a product does not work.
apps.loved: The idea of getting a separate number for different tasks is clear and in demand.
apps.weak: The assigned number can disappear at any moment without warning.
apps.whoFor: Not recommended

apps.title: Live Messages - StickLive
apps.verdict: The app promises to turn chat screenshots into formatted stickers, but almost all functionality is behind a paywall from the very first message. There is no real value as a communication tool — this is customization for its own sake with a minimal free tier.
apps.loved: The idea of overlaying a styled sticker on top of a real message looks visually interesting.
apps.weak: Stickers do not fit over other people's messages well: the scale is off and the orientation is wrong.
apps.whoFor: Teenagers who want to decorate chat screenshots

apps.title: MeetMe: Go Live & Meet People
apps.verdict: The chat feed hangs and shows 'loading' indefinitely, streams crash every 4 to 5 minutes, face verification does not work, and the majority of profiles are bots or scammers. The product is broken across all key functions.
apps.loved: Streamers receive a higher share of gift revenue than on large platforms.
apps.weak: Opening the incoming message list is impossible — the app freezes on loading.
apps.whoFor: Streamers for whom gift monetization matters more than reach

apps.title: Text App: Calling+Texting Now
apps.verdict: The app is positioned as an SMS replacement, but it only works within its own network. Writing to anyone in your regular contacts is impossible unless they also install this messenger.
apps.loved: The interface looks like a standard calls-and-messages app.
apps.weak: Communication with numbers outside the app does not work, even though that is exactly what the description promises.
apps.whoFor: Not recommended

apps.title: Litstick - Best Stickers App
apps.verdict: Litstick is a sticker overlay for pranks, not a messenger: it creates a fake-chat image to place over a screenshot. Most users do not understand how it works, the sticker does not match the chat bubble size, and the vast majority of reviews express disappointment.
apps.loved: The idea appealed to people who wanted to prank their friends.
apps.weak: The sticker overlay does not scale to actual message bubbles, so the result always looks fake.
apps.whoFor: Teenagers who want to fake a chat screenshot for a prank

apps.title: Flirtini - Match, Chat, Flirt
apps.verdict: The app is positioned as a dating service, but the overwhelming majority of active profiles are described by male users as bots or people requesting money. Genuine meetings are rare, chat is unstable, and the like algorithm is opaque.
apps.loved: A handful of real users did find connections, which shows the concept can work.
apps.weak: There is no way to tell a live profile from a bot without paying to reveal a match.
apps.whoFor: Not recommended in its current state

apps.title: BonChat
apps.loved: Technically the basic chat features work correctly.
apps.whoFor: Not recommended

apps.title: TeasyChat: Make New Chat Room
apps.verdict: The app is filled with bots posing as real people: the same phrases, conversations that drop after two messages, and AI avatars. There is no real communication.
apps.loved: Some users find it useful for killing time in a one-sided way.
apps.weak: Nearly all conversation partners are bots or fake profiles — genuine interaction does not happen.
apps.whoFor: Not recommended
